title: Jammy Molten Norwegian Mushroom Casserole
description: A rich and savory Norwegian dish featuring mushrooms and rest-meat in a jammy molten sauce, macrobiotic-friendly and perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Sauté the mushrooms and onion in olive oil until the mushrooms release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the rest-meat and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
In a separate saucepan, whisk together the flour and vegetable broth, then bring to a boil and cook until thickened.
Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in the norwegian cheese until melted and smooth.

In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange a layer of the mushroom and meat mixture, followed by a layer of the cheese sauce, and repeat until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of cheese sauce on top.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the casserole is hot and the cheese is melted and jammy.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
